The exact reported useMutation is a controller owner. Its isPending state reaches private Add, editor Save, category and delete controls; the same parent renders a stable visible polite/atomic Saving/Saved region. Existing destructive Alert reports failure; onSuccess updates the cache and clears only intended successful drafts/intents. Deferred real-component tests verify POST pending feedback, disabled repeat activation, success/failure drafts, and one DELETE with the captured version. The scanner does not follow the controller object through extracted controls. Reconsider if a control stops consuming pending, feedback leaves this owner or mutation/intent ownership changes. Eight actual Chromium cases additionally verify keyboard pending focus, repeat activation, failures, light/dark, narrow/wide layout, reduced motion and axe through synthetic transport.

Actual window Cmd/Ctrl+K listener guards handled events, composition, repeats, modifiers, editable targets and other popups. Window bubbling preserves Support/Care shortcut ownership; non-editing own popup toggles closed.
Mission Control mounts app-owned search backed by existing role-filtered navigation and real router.push commands. Scanner cannot follow the feature component and its dynamic mapped CommandItems.
Both actual memory category controls use SelectControlLabel, the Base UI Select.Label wrapper, which associates with their trigger.
Offline gift DialogContent renders child form containing DialogTitle. Actual composed dialog is named Enter offline gift while open.
Memory panel explicitly renders genuine empty or filtered result as a polite No matching private memory status. Scanner fails to follow derived entries.

This application has the supported Next.js global-error.tsx convention with complete document markup and a named reset action. The scanner requires the ordinary error.tsx filename and overlooks the verified global boundary.
Resend renders FieldError through getRenderableErrors; credential field now exposes aria-invalid and references its error ID. Shared AppFields also own visible field errors.
Exact moderation action icon button receives Open actions from its Base UI DropdownMenuTrigger render composition.
SidebarMenuSubButton render Link receives the parent sub.title text through Base UI composition. Actual rendered submenu links are named Moderation and Org Updates.
Exact flagged Eve operations navigation is an always-visible responsive grid, rather than hidden site navigation that needs a mobile panel.
Exact route delegates to locked Payload NotFoundPage; installed NotFoundClient renders configured backToDashboard link. Modern app global-not-found also has Return home recovery.
Exact flagged Template name is document metadata, not a personal email address. Rendering proves labelled text input with Newsletter value and no email-purpose token.
Exact draft preview intentionally blocks authentication, redirect/notFound and current record resolution before response flush. Adding Suspense here would change intended HTTP/auth behavior.

Core explicitly requires one shared base-maia components.json in packages/ui and rejects app-local copies. The scanner checks only the application-local file and misses that enforced monorepo ownership.

This private application retains its existing noindex publication policy. A public social preview is not a required private-workspace feature, so no public image/card is introduced solely for the scanner score.

Exact pending kill-switch label has a corresponding visible polite status in owning EveGovernanceView, naming that switch. Controls are disabled throughout. Scanner restricts detection to the local KillSwitchControl function and misses owning status.
The application deliberately forces the light theme. A global dark-mode shortcut would contradict the mounted provider contract, so it is intentionally omitted.

The donor dashboard layout renders DonorPortalHeader, which mounts the shared NavigationCommandPalette inside its existing action group. It reuses SECTIONS plus Settings and router.push for the six owned dashboard destinations. The shared primitive composes CommandDialog, input, empty state and actionable items with guarded Ctrl/Meta+K. Shadscan 0.17.0 inspects app-owned source scopes and misses this shared-package implementation. The cited caller and shared-primitive Vitest suites verify route filtering and selection, Ctrl/Meta+K, Escape focus return, and non-interception of editable drafts and the account menu. No browser verification is claimed.

use-profile-page-view validates and sets field errors; ProfilePageClient passes vm.validationErrors into ProfileFormColumn, whose FormField delegates to shared LabeledField. That Base UI wrapper associates Field.Error with stable control IDs, aria-invalid and description/error IDs. The actual missionary wrapper unit test verifies the control/error seam, not the complete page submission.

All five raw Input call sites are immediate children of FormField with explicit first-name, last-name, location, phone or tagline labels. FormField delegates to LabeledField and Base UI Field.Control. The missionary wrapper unit test exercises actual Input and native Textarea names and association IDs; it does not render the entire profile page or establish browser behavior.

The raw DonorTasks render Button receives aria-label Open actions from DropdownMenuTrigger. Current exact-caller DOM tests find that named trigger, activate Delete, and verify confirmation/focus and deferred duplicate prevention. Shared Trigger/Button tests separately establish Base UI render-prop name propagation. No browser run is claimed.

The raw Settings render Link is inside SidebarAccountMenu DropdownMenuItem with visible Settings children. Base UI forwards those children to the anchor. The exact account-menu DOM test verifies its accessible Settings name and /settings href; shared composition tests establish the same anchor bridge. The former AppHeader/About proof is not the current owner.

The raw ChangePasswordForm onSubmit calls validate(values), stores field errors and returns before any auth call when invalid; successful validation checks the current password before updating it. LabeledField renders those errors. Exact-caller unit tests verify short/mismatched/reused password rejection and no server mutation, plus current-password errors and success. CommentsDialog required-input tests are not evidence for this current raw owner.

SidebarAccountMenu awaits signOutClientSession inside useTransition. Its isSigningOut value disables the actual Base UI menu item and changes its visible label to Signing out until the operation settles. The scanner does not recognize that transition-state name. The deferred real-menu test reopens the menu during the request, verifies the visible pending label and aria-disabled, rejects repeat activation, and verifies readiness after settlement. Source review and DOM tests support this exact finding; no browser or successful sign-out operation is claimed.
